f0001.note: Four '[HANG DETECTED] Card hang detected' and two 'TT_THROW ... TIMEOUT: device timeout' from the dispatch system memory manager. Merged deliberately: the hang detector and the dispatch timeout are two instruments reporting one wedged device, and splitting them would count one hardware event twice.
